Dagny VossA clean lane before Hour 12. Show me ranging lock to four metres, and I will not touch the key. I will also want to see the thing I am sparing. I do not break my own payroll over a diagram.

IlluminaraThen take the heartbeat. Dr. Achterberg can put it on this panel. While the shells are whole it is a single clean note. We will log its starting width. If the note widens by more than five percent, the shells are falling out of step and the test has breached its limit.

Kemal AydinWhich means you are handing her the right to stop you.

IlluminaraIt was always hers.

Dagny VossAnd if you are wrong, I want it on the record that I warned you, and that every hour I waited cost me a hauler contract.

IlluminaraIt will be on the record. The cost will be too.

Dagny VossThen do it. At Hour 12 Kemal turns the comb unless the lane is improving and that note is within five percent of its starting width. If either measure turns against you, he holds the fields where they are and I decide whether you get one recovery window or the comb. I will not be asked twice.

04 · Two Ribbons

Oss and Lamentine field arrays · Hour 8 to Hour 10:30

At Hour 8:10 the first ribbon ran out from Oss, south and away from the lane: a faint coherent edge, drawn as cleanly as the arrays could draw it. The second ran from Lamentine across the corridor, a decoy and a control. Illuminara wrote her prediction in the station log before either went live. The knots would leave the rails for the outbound ribbon within ninety minutes. If they took neither, or the crossing one, she was wrong, and she wrote that too.

They did nothing for seventy minutes. On Voss's panel the heartbeat held one clean note, and Aydin counted the minutes aloud in a flat voice.

At Hour 9:20 the knots moved. They did not take the outbound ribbon, and they did not take the crossing one. They settled on the seam where the two edges overlapped, a line nobody had drawn, running a hundred and forty kilometres along the lane's southern rail.

Sunniva AchterbergThey declined both.

IlluminaraNo. They chose the best edge in the sky, and I built it by accident. I had them picking between my offers.

Ngozi Farrant, on the lineI will not enter above eighty metres. My fix just went to a hundred and twenty metres. Tell me that is the end of the bad news.

IlluminaraIt is the middle. I made the lane worse.

She said it once, at the volume she would have used for a measurement, and went back to the screen. It was Hour 10:35.

05 · The Seam

Oss field array, control room · Hour 10:40

IlluminaraThe seam sits where the two ribbons are equal. Weaken the crossing one and strengthen the outbound one by the same amount, and the seam slides south without becoming brighter. Slide it slowly and the knots may follow it, because it remains coherent.

Sunniva AchterbergOr charged dust is simply collecting where the fields cancel. Then coherence has nothing to do with it.

Kemal Aydin, on the lineI can rotate both phases equally and oppositely for forty seconds. The seam stays within two kilometres and total field strength within one percent, but the edge loses coherence. If the knots follow strength or geometry, they stay. If they follow coherence, their track should loosen before the six-minute mark.

IlluminaraFreeze that prediction in the log. Forty seconds only. If the heartbeat widens by more than five percent, restore phase at once. If their track does not loosen within six minutes, my model fails and we do not begin the slide.

At Hour 10:47 Aydin rotated the phases. The seam did not move on the ranging plot. Seventy seconds later the outer knots lifted from it and began to wander, though the heartbeat remained narrow. He restored coherence at forty seconds; within four minutes the same knots had gathered along the seam again. They had not chosen either ribbon. They had answered a property of the edge.

Sunniva AchterbergThat defeats accumulation. It does not prove what they are, but it tells us what not to break.

IlluminaraThen we move only one thing: the position of a coherent seam.

Sunniva AchterbergThe arrays cannot hold their phase that precisely. They wander. Noise is exactly what the knots flee.

IlluminaraThen I will be the clock. I can feel which way each field is bending a breath before your instruments log it. I cannot move the knots, or the dust, or the shells. I can tell each of you which way you are drifting and by how much.

Ibrahim TadesseLamentine has eleven days of grain in sealed silos, but only fourteen hours of bread already baked. The mill reserve keeps the grinders and ovens alive through a brownout. Give it to the array and the mill stays cold until we release the field power. Households eat yesterday's loaves, and the outer stations still need these convoys.

IlluminaraI will not pretend that is a small price.

Ibrahim TadesseI authorize fourteen hours. The mill restarts the moment the array releases the reserve. Take it.

At Hour 11:00 she began calling corrections over two channels, one voice to Oss and one to Lamentine. At Hour 11:06 she called Oss drifting 0.18 degrees sunward; the instrument alarm crossed the same threshold 3.2 seconds later, and Aydin entered both times in Voss's log.

At Hour 11:29 Lamentine stepped against her call. This time the array alarm sounded 0.6 seconds before she corrected it. The outermost shells loosened for eleven seconds before the seam recovered. Her lead was real, and it was not constant enough to make the ecology safe by itself.

The seam crept south. The knots flowed along it like seeds along a tide line.

At Hour 11:41 Voss's voice came over the speaker, level and dry.

Dagny Voss, on the lineThe heartbeat is twelve percent broader. My line was five. Aydin has his hand on the comb.

Illuminara did not argue. She ordered the arrays held exactly where they were.

IlluminaraThe pull outran the young. The older keepers came with the seam and the newest shells could not keep the pace. I set the slope too fast. Give me until Hour 12:05 with the seam still. If the width is not within five percent of its starting line, turn the key. If it recovers, grant twenty minutes at half speed. Renew only while two ten-minute reads show the width holding and the ranging error falling.

Dagny Voss, on the lineThat is the recovery window. Five percent by Hour 12:05. After that, twenty minutes at a time. One bad pair of reads and Kemal fires without another speech.

At Hour 12:01 the heartbeat narrowed to four percent above its starting width. Aydin read the number himself. The laggards had caught up, and the braid closed behind them like a hand.

Kemal Aydin, on the lineFour percent. Ranging error is falling. The condition is met.

Dagny Voss, on the lineResume. Half the speed. Your window ends at Hour 12:21 unless the next pair earns another.

06 · Clean Glass

Oss Station and the lane · Hour 15 to Hour 31

By Hour 15 the seam lay two hundred kilometres south of the rail, and the braid lay with it, a long violet comma pointing away from the lane. Voss had renewed the twenty-minute window eight times, each after Aydin read two improving fixes and a heartbeat no more than five percent wide. Ranging lock came back in steps: eighty metres, forty, nine, four. At Hour 15:01, with the lane clean and the same limits holding, she converted the last interval into a standing order through the final crossing and Lamentine's controlled release.

Beyond the ribbons' crossing point, the comet's own southward field gradient ran parallel to the Oss outbound ribbon. Together they made the sole quiet edge; Lamentine's crossing array no longer set the seam's position. Aydin reduced that array in three logged steps, and the braid did not move or widen.

Ngozi FarrantFour. Four and holding. I said I would not enter above eighty metres, and I am entering at four on my own judgement, not because anyone told me it was safe. Ardent is in the lane.

Illuminara watched the scatter chart flatten on Oss's screen. The three convoys crossed one behind another, at half speed, through the narrow clean band, and the last cleared the closing line with nine hours to spare. Lamentine released its array at Hour 15:12 after the third stable step; the Oss ribbon and the comet's gradient held the braid on the new edge. The mill restarted on stored grain before the fourteen-hour bread shelf was empty. The convoys would reach the stations two days behind schedule; Pelion and Kestrel would receive them before either opened its seed stores.

Voss came to the observation ring herself, with the key on its cord. Tadesse joined by public line, carrying Oss Council's emergency navigation seal.

Dagny VossA season. The north face remains mine, but I surrender extraction on the south face while the heartbeat band is active. That cost is mine, and the charter will say so in writing.

Ibrahim Tadesse, on the lineOss Council declares the same band a protected navigation exclusion through perihelion. Voss-Kane's assent and the public order expire together at the season's end unless both are renewed.

IlluminaraIt stopped being a diagram when each of you could measure what your choice would harm.

Ibrahim Tadesse, on the lineThe new beacons will be paid for by every hauler on the lane. Nobody has agreed to that yet.

Sunniva AchterbergThen that argument begins tomorrow. The next braid will not wait for us to finish it.

On the screen the heartbeat held its single clean note, and under it, new and faint, a second tone that had not been there before. Achterberg turned it up. Nobody could say what it meant, and Illuminara did not offer a guess. She asked, instead, that one ribbon be left on at a whisper through the season. Voss looked once at Aydin's trace, then nodded.

KOMETOV DRUGI REP

01 · Glavnik

Postaja Oss, opazovalni obroč · Ura 0 od 40

Enajst dni pred perihelijem je kometu Maren-Quill zrasel drugi rep, ta pa se je premikal v napačno smer. Prvi je tekel stran od Sonca, kakor repi morajo. Novi se je plazil navzgor v sončni veter, tanka vijolična kita, ki je odmetavala vozle nabitega prahu; ti so se kotalili čez tovorni koridor kakor semena čez cesto.

Sunniva AchterbergTi vozli so živi, v katerem koli pomenu je lahko živo polje. Prah zlagajo v lupine, v vsaki lupini pa nekaj ohranja srčni utrip na nizkem radijskem pasu. Devet tisoč lupin, večinoma mladih, toda njihovi pulzni pasovi kažejo starejše skrbnike ob zunanjem robu in na novo zložene lupine znotraj. Svetu sem povedala, da vozle privlačijo naši merilni žarki: vsaka lupina razprši našo navigacijo. Žarek pride iz te kite kakor svetloba skozi motno steklo.

Ibrahim TadesseLamentinovi zaprti silosi lahko njegove mline oskrbujejo enajst dni, vendar ima Pelion žita za tri dni, Kestrel pa za dva. Koridor se ob periheliju čez štirideset ur zapre in ostane zaprt šest tednov. Ardent in druga dva konvoja morajo prečkati pred tem, sicer bodo zunanje postaje pojedle semensko zalogo pred naslednjim oknom.

Dagny Voss, po zveziKometa pa je moja, svetnica, po listini Voss-Kane, do zadnjega grama niklja. Listina imetnici dovoljuje odstraniti nevarnost za plovbo z lastne pravice. Ob 12. uri sprožim glavnik. Štirideset minut in koridor bo čist kakor steklo.

Sunniva AchterbergIn z njim tudi jasli. Magnetno prečesavanje raztrga vsako lupino.

Dagny Voss, po zveziPrebrala sem vaš članek, doktorica. Lepa kita. Štiristo ljudi prejema plačo od te pravice in ne bodo je prejemali od kite.

Illuminara je ves čas stala pri oknu in opazovala vijolično nit na zaslonu pod zvezdami. Nihče je še ni vprašal za mnenje. Ni ga ponudila.

IlluminaraNe povzetka. Surove sledi. Vsak vozel, vsako minuto od nastanka kite.

Sunniva AchterbergTo sta dva terabajta čečkanja.

IlluminaraPotem tega še nihče ni prebral.

02 · Svetilnik, ki je izgubil uro

Postaja Oss, sledilni oddelek · Ura 3

Sledi je brala, kakor je brala obraz, in iskala kraj, kjer se pričakovano ni zgodilo. Potrebovala je uro in deset minut. Našla ga je v štirideset minut dolgi vrzeli.

Ko je posnetek dosegel napako, je Illuminara 2,1 sekunde pred oznako instrumenta poimenovala fazno nihanje 0,04 stopinje; sledilni tehnik je preveril dnevnik in potrdil njeno prednost.

IlluminaraSvetilnik devet je včeraj ob 22:10 izgubil uro — po stenskem času, preden se je začelo naše štirideseturno štetje. Njegova faza je tavala štirideset minut. Poglejte vozle v tem času.

Sunniva AchterbergRazmaknili so se. Okoli svetilnika, v mehurju. Imela sem ga za napako tipala.

IlluminaraRazmaknili so se natanko za štirideset minut in se sklenili v trenutku, ko se je ura vrnila. Svetu ste povedali, da vozli lovijo žarke. Nekaj, kar lovi žarke, bi se zgnetlo okoli tistega, ki je kričal.

Sunniva AchterbergRazen če se izogibajo vsemu neskladnemu.

IlluminaraIn ne odnaša jih naključno. Vsaka nit teče vzdolž starih vodilnih tirnic, magnetnih robov, položenih zato, da bi žarki ostali čisti. Tirnice so najtišji, najravnejši robovi v štiridesetih milijonih kilometrov.

Sunniva AchterbergPotem smo jim zgradili cesto. In jih povabili nanjo.

Ngozi Farrant, po zveziPotem prekinite tirnice.

IlluminaraPotem z njimi izgine tudi vaše merjenje, koridor postane šum in ne vem, kaj naredi mlada lupina, ko njena cesta postane hrup.

Sunniva AchterbergRazpade. Tako bi ugibala.

IlluminaraTo je ugibanje in odgovora raje ne bi spoznala tako, da bi imela prav. Kaj če ponudimo nekaj tišjega, daljšega in čistejšega od tirnic, kar vodi stran od prometa?

Sunniva AchterbergPredpostavljate, da sprejemajo ponudbe.

IlluminaraNičesar ne predpostavljam. Videti želim, ali jih zavrnejo.

03 · Ključ

Platforma Voss-Kane, nadzor glavnika · Ura 6

Dagny Voss je ključ za sprožitev nosila na vrvici okoli lastnega vratu. Njen inženir Kemal Aydin je stal pri nadzorni plošči z rokami v žepih, kar je Illuminara razumela kot vljudnost.

Dagny VossPrišli ste me prosit, naj čakam.

IlluminaraPrišla sem vprašat, zaradi česa ne bi sprožili.

Dagny VossČist koridor pred 12. uro. Pokažite mi merilno fiksiranje na štiri metre in ključa se ne dotaknem. Videti hočem tudi stvar, ki ji prizanašam. Zaradi diagrama ne bom zlomila lastne plačilne liste.

IlluminaraPotem vzemite srčni utrip. Doktorica Achterberg ga lahko prenese na to ploščo. Dokler so lupine cele, je to en sam čist ton. Zabeležili bomo njegovo začetno širino. Če se ton razširi za več kot pet odstotkov, lupine izgubljajo skupni ritem in preizkus je prestopil svojo mejo.

Kemal AydinKar pomeni, da ji izročate pravico, da vas ustavi.

IlluminaraVedno je bila njena.

Dagny VossIn če se motite, hočem v zapisniku, da sem vas posvarila in da me je vsaka ura čakanja stala pogodbe s tovornjakom.

IlluminaraTo bo v zapisniku. Tudi strošek bo.

Dagny VossPotem storite. Ob 12. uri Kemal sproži glavnik, razen če se koridor izboljšuje in je ta ton znotraj petih odstotkov začetne širine. Če se katera koli mera obrne proti vam, obdrži polja tam, kjer so, jaz pa odločim, ali dobite eno obnovitveno okno ali glavnik. Dvakrat me ne boste prosili.

04 · Dva trakova

Poljske mreže Oss in Lamentine · Ura 8 do 10:30

Ob 8:10 je iz Ossa stekel prvi trak, proti jugu in stran od koridorja: šibek skladen rob, izrisan tako čisto, kakor so ga mreže zmogle izrisati. Drugi je stekel iz Lamentina čez koridor, kot vaba in kontrola. Illuminara je napoved zapisala v postajni dnevnik, preden je kateri koli oživel. Vozli naj bi v devetdesetih minutah zapustili tirnice in odšli na izhodni trak. Če ne bi izbrali nobenega ali pa bi izbrali prečnega, bi se motila, in zapisala je tudi to.

Sedemdeset minut niso naredili ničesar. Na Vossini plošči je srčni utrip ohranjal en sam čist ton, Aydin pa je z ravnim glasom na glas štel minute.

Ob 9:20 so se vozli premaknili. Niso izbrali izhodnega traku in niso izbrali prečnega. Namestili so se na spoj, kjer sta se roba prekrivala, na črto, ki je ni narisal nihče in je tekla sto štirideset kilometrov vzdolž južne tirnice koridorja.

Sunniva AchterbergOba so zavrnili.

IlluminaraNe. Izbrali so najboljši rob na nebu in po nesreči sem ga zgradila jaz. Silila sem jih izbirati med mojima ponudbama.

Ngozi Farrant, po zveziNe bom vstopila nad osemdesetimi metri. Moje fiksiranje je pravkar poskočilo na sto dvajset metrov. Recite mi, da je to konec slabih novic.

IlluminaraTo je sredina. Poslabšala sem koridor.

Izrekla je enkrat, z glasnostjo, ki bi jo uporabila za meritev, in se vrnila k zaslonu. Bila je ura 10:35.

05 · Spoj

Poljska mreža Oss, nadzorna soba · Ura 10:40

IlluminaraSpoj leži tam, kjer sta trakova enaka. Oslabite prečnega in za enako vrednost okrepite izhodnega, pa spoj zdrsne proti jugu, ne da bi postal svetlejši. Premikajte ga počasi in vozli mu bodo morda sledili, ker ostaja skladen.

Sunniva AchterbergAli pa se nabiti prah preprosto zbira tam, kjer se polji izničita. Potem skladnost s tem nima ničesar.

Kemal Aydin, po zveziObe fazi lahko za štirideset sekund zavrtim enako in v nasprotni smeri. Spoj ostane znotraj dveh kilometrov, skupna jakost polja pa znotraj enega odstotka, vendar rob izgubi skladnost. Če vozli sledijo jakosti ali geometriji, ostanejo. Če sledijo skladnosti, bi se morala njihova sled zrahljati pred šesto minuto.

IlluminaraTo napoved zamrznite v dnevniku. Samo štirideset sekund. Če se srčni utrip razširi za več kot pet odstotkov, nemudoma obnovite fazo. Če se njihova sled v šestih minutah ne zrahlja, moj model odpove in drsenja ne začnemo.

Ob 10:47 je Aydin zavrtel fazi. Spoj se na merilnem prikazu ni premaknil. Sedemdeset sekund pozneje so se zunanji vozli dvignili z njega in začeli tavati, srčni utrip pa je ostal ozek. Po štiridesetih sekundah je obnovil skladnost; v štirih minutah so se isti vozli znova zbrali vzdolž spoja. Niso izbrali nobenega traku. Odgovorili so na lastnost roba.

Sunniva AchterbergTo ovrže kopičenje. Ne dokazuje, kaj so, pove pa nam, česa ne smemo zlomiti.

IlluminaraPotem premaknemo samo eno stvar: položaj skladnega spoja.

Sunniva AchterbergMreži ne moreta tako natančno ohranjati faze. Tavata. Vozli bežijo prav pred šumom.

IlluminaraPotem bom jaz ura. Začutim lahko, v katero smer se vsako polje upogiba, en dih preden to zapišejo vaši instrumenti. Ne morem premakniti vozlov, prahu ali lupin. Vsakemu izmed vas lahko povem, v katero smer vas odnaša in za koliko.

Ibrahim TadesseLamentine ima v zaprtih silosih žita za enajst dni, vendar le štirinajst ur že pečenega kruha. Rezerva mlina ohranja mline in peči pri življenju med izpadom elektrike. Dajte jo mreži in mlin ostane hladen, dokler ne sprostimo poljske moči. Gospodinjstva bodo jedla včerajšnje hlebce, zunanje postaje pa te konvoje še vedno potrebujejo.

IlluminaraNe bom se pretvarjala, da je to majhna cena.

Ibrahim TadesseOdobrim štirinajst ur. Mlin se znova zažene v trenutku, ko mreža sprosti rezervo. Vzemite jo.

Ob 11:00 je začela sporočati popravke po dveh kanalih, z enim glasom Ossu in drugim Lamentinu. Ob 11:06 je povedala, da Oss odnaša za 0,18 stopinje proti Soncu; alarm instrumenta je isti prag prestopil 3,2 sekunde pozneje, Aydin pa je oba časa vpisal v Vossin dnevnik.

Ob 11:29 je Lamentine stopil proti njenemu navodilu. Tokrat se je alarm mreže oglasil 0,6 sekunde, preden ga je popravila. Najbolj zunanje lupine so se razrahljale za enajst sekund, preden se je spoj obnovil. Njena prednost je bila resnična in ne dovolj stalna, da bi sama po sebi zagotovila varnost ekologije.

Spoj je lezel proti jugu. Vozli so tekli vzdolž njega kakor semena vzdolž črte plime.

Ob 11:41 se je iz zvočnika oglasil Vossin glas, raven in suh.

Dagny Voss, po zveziSrčni utrip je dvanajst odstotkov širši. Moja meja je bila pet. Aydin ima roko na glavniku.

Illuminara ni ugovarjala. Ukazala je, naj mreži ostaneta natanko tam, kjer sta.

IlluminaraVleka je prehitela mlade. Starejši skrbniki so šli s spojem, najnovejše lupine pa niso zmogle tempa. Naklon sem nastavila prehitro. Dajte mi čas do 12:05 in spoj naj miruje. Če širina ni znotraj petih odstotkov začetne črte, obrnite ključ. Če si opomore, odobrite dvajset minut pri polovični hitrosti. Podaljšajte samo, dokler dva desetminutna odčitka kažeta, da širina drži, napaka merjenja pa pada.

Dagny Voss, po zveziTo je obnovitveno okno. Pet odstotkov do 12:05. Nato po dvajset minut naenkrat. En slab par odčitkov in Kemal sproži brez novega govora.

Ob 12:01 se je srčni utrip zožil na štiri odstotke nad začetno širino. Aydin je številko prebral sam. Zaostali so ujeli druge in kita se je za njimi zaprla kakor dlan.

Kemal Aydin, po zveziŠtirje odstotki. Napaka merjenja pada. Pogoj je izpolnjen.

Dagny Voss, po zveziNadaljujte. Polovična hitrost. Vaše okno se konča ob 12:21, razen če si naslednji par prisluži novega.

06 · Čisto steklo

Postaja Oss in koridor · Ura 15 do 31

Do 15. ure je spoj ležal dvesto kilometrov južno od tirnice, z njim pa tudi kita, dolga vijolična vejica, obrnjena stran od koridorja. Voss je dvajsetminutno okno podaljšala osemkrat, vsakič potem, ko je Aydin prebral dve izboljšani fiksiranji in srčni utrip, širok največ pet odstotkov. Merilno fiksiranje se je vračalo po korakih: osemdeset metrov, štirideset, devet, štiri. Ob 15:01, ko je bil koridor čist in so iste meje še vedno držale, je zadnji interval spremenila v trajni ukaz do končnega prečkanja in Lamentinovega nadzorovanega izklopa.

Onkraj presečišča trakov je lastni južni gradient kometovega polja tekel vzporedno z Ossovim izhodnim trakom. Skupaj sta tvorila edini tihi rob; Lamentinova prečna mreža ni več določala položaja spoja. Aydin je to mrežo zmanjšal v treh zabeleženih korakih in kita se ni premaknila ali razširila.

Ngozi FarrantŠtiri. Štiri in drži. Rekla sem, da ne bom vstopila nad osemdesetimi metri, vstopam pa pri štirih po lastni presoji, ne zato, ker mi je kdo rekel, da je varno. Ardent je v koridorju.

Illuminara je opazovala, kako se graf razpršitve na Ossovem zaslonu izravnava. Trije konvoji so prečkali drug za drugim, s polovično hitrostjo, skozi ozek čisti pas, zadnji pa je črto zapiranja prešel z devetimi urami prednosti. Lamentine je svojo mrežo sprostil ob 15:12 po tretjem stabilnem koraku; Ossov trak in kometov gradient sta kito zadržala na novem robu. Mlin se je znova zagnal z uskladiščenim žitom, preden se je iztekla štirinajsturna zaloga kruha. Konvoji bi do postaj prišli dva dni pozneje od načrta; Pelion in Kestrel bi ju prejela, preden bi kateri koli odprl svojo semensko zalogo.

Voss je sama prišla v opazovalni obroč s ključem na vrvici. Tadesse se je pridružil po javni zvezi in nosil nujni navigacijski pečat sveta Oss.

Dagny VossEno sezono. Severna stran ostane moja, vendar se odpovedujem izkopavanju na južni strani, dokler je pas srčnega utripa dejaven. Ta strošek je moj in v listini bo tako pisalo.

Ibrahim Tadesse, po zveziSvet Oss razglaša isti pas za zaščiteno navigacijsko izključitveno območje do perihelija. Soglasje Voss-Kane in javni odlok prenehata skupaj ob koncu sezone, razen če sta oba obnovljena.

IlluminaraDiagram je prenehal biti v trenutku, ko je lahko vsak izmed vas izmeril, čemu bi njegova izbira škodovala.

Ibrahim Tadesse, po zveziNove svetilnike bo plačal vsak tovornjak na koridorju. S tem se še ni strinjal nihče.

Sunniva AchterbergPotem se ta spor začne jutri. Naslednja kita ne bo čakala, da ga končamo.

Na zaslonu je srčni utrip ohranjal svoj en sam čist ton, pod njim pa je bil nov, šibek drugi ton, ki ga prej ni bilo. Achterberg ga je ojačala. Nihče ni mogel povedati, kaj pomeni, in Illuminara ni ponudila ugibanja. Namesto tega je prosila, naj en trak skozi sezono ostane prižgan na šepetu. Voss je enkrat pogledala Aydinovo sled in nato prikimala.

THE DAY WREN WAS RIGHT

A floating market of twelve hundred households has thirty days to meet a sanitation law it genuinely breaks, and the plan that would save it is wrong in the one way only Wren could see.

01 · The Clean Plan

Harbour Office quay, Sorrel Water · Day 3 of 30, 08:10

The Order was fourteen pages long and gave thirty days, and on the third morning Illuminara laid her answer across the Harbour Office counter on a single sheet.

Twelve hundred boat-households lived on Kettle Market. The Harbourmaster's Sanitation Order No. 14 said that after the fifteenth of November none of them could go on discharging into Sorrel Water, and the August samples had shown the Order was right. Illuminara's sheet showed a licensed pump-out barge, six fixed stops, a sensor in every tank and one monthly bill.

Cedric AldanaIt is the cleanest compliance plan anyone has put in front of me. Every vessel metered, every pump-out logged. I could sign it on a Friday.

Wren Odira came up the quay steps with smoke in her coat and river mud to the knee. She had spent three weeks sleeping on other people's decks. She read the sheet standing, twice, and set it down.

Wren OdiraIt will fail.

IlluminaraTell me where it breaks first.

Wren OdiraWherever the barge is when the string has moved. Kettle doesn't sit at six stops. It re-rafts on every ebb, boats slide to be near the boats they owe. Your stop six holds a hundred and forty hulls on Monday and sixty on Thursday. And you meter the tank. Whoever pays by the tank learns to keep it half empty and the hose long.

IlluminaraA meter that pays a family to leave the harbour dirty. I did not model that.

Wren OdiraYou modelled a machine. It's a rumour with a rota.

Illuminara did not defend the sheet. Wren has the shape of it. I do not yet have one fact that is worth more than her three weeks.

IlluminaraThen something is already working. In August the water was bad, not lethal, and Kettle has lived on it for thirty years. Who keeps the record of how?

Wren OdiraThere's a book.

Cedric AldanaThe Order wants a record for each vessel. A book is not a record.

IlluminaraThen I would like to read the book before I tell you what a record is.

02 · The Tie-Book

Dock-mistress's counter, Kettle Market · Day 4, 06:00

Odalys Ferreira kept eleven volumes of the tie-book under her counter, in pencil, because ink runs on a wet quay. She laid the current one open and kept one hand flat on it.

Odalys FerreiraYou may read here. You may not copy a page, and if I see you reading a name you weren't asked to, I close it. This book is the only thing on the water that nobody has ever been able to buy.

Illuminara read for six hours. Selka carried Reed 3, 5, 7. Tues. Pump to Mill 2, from Mabuya, back by dusk. Tied: Aurelian, visitor. Line by line she let the entries fall into place as a graph: strings of rafted boats, carriers who wheeled the waste to the barge quay on days each string had chosen, pumps that travelled on a promise.

Nobody had written down a rota. The book was the rota, kept in the one language the market trusted.

IlluminaraEight boats in ten pass their waste to a carrier, the carrier takes it to the licensed quay, and the book shows eleven years of corrections. Thirty-eight strings, and none has ever asked the Harbourmaster for anything.

Wren OdiraI told you.

IlluminaraYou did, and you were right about the form. It fails in three places, and I find them by what the book leaves out. First, Reed Row. Tuesdays and Fridays, every week for eleven years. Not one carry on a Sunday.

Odalys FerreiraSunday is rest. Reed Row rests hardest of any string.

IlluminaraSecond. Every pump loan in this volume names Mabuya or Mabuya's spare. One pump, one owner, who is seventy-nine.

Odalys FerreiraGwil Anand will outlive the harbour.

IlluminaraThird, and it is the one the Inspector cares about. Nothing here lets the Order learn that any of this happened without opening the book to him.

Odalys FerreiraThat is what the book is for.

IlluminaraI know. I will come back to it. But the first two I only suspect. The book cannot tell me whether Reed Row's Sunday waste goes into the water, and half this harbour will say the water is dirty because of the tannery drain upstream.

Wren OdiraThey'll say it before you've finished the sentence.

IlluminaraThen we measure before anyone claims anything.

03 · Three Stations

Sorrel Water, on the ebb · Saturday 22:00 to Monday 06:00

Pia Zane, who ran the Inspector's small laboratory out of a van, set four sample stations and was told by Illuminara which results would count against her.

Illuminara wrote the predictions on a card, sealed it, and gave it to Aldana before the first bottle was filled. If the Sunday gap was real, Reed Row's mouth would run at least five times its Saturday reading on the Sunday ebb while the station above the market stayed flat. If the tannery was the cause, the upstream station would be high on both nights and Reed Row would barely differ from it. If neither, everything would be flat and she would have been wrong about the book.

Hesper QuillYou are sampling Reed Row on our day of rest. You will write our shame in water and hand it to the Inspector.

IlluminaraI am sampling the one place your string cannot answer for. If the number is bad on Sunday, it will be the first fact either of us has that is ours to fix.

Hesper QuillAnd if it's bad on Saturday too?

IlluminaraThen I am wrong and the card says so.

Wren rowed the bottles herself, one leg of the route at a time. The numbers came back on Monday at six, in enterococci per hundred millilitres.

Pia ZaneSaturday ebb. Upstream, ninety. Reed Row, two hundred and ten. Mid-market, a hundred and eighty. Below the market, two hundred and sixty. Sunday ebb. Upstream, a hundred and ten. Reed Row, two thousand three hundred. Mid-market, six-forty. Below, seven hundred.

Wren OdiraUpstream is flat.

Pia ZaneThe tannery adds something after rain. It is not this.

IlluminaraThe tannery is a fact and it is not this fact. It will still be there when we finish, and I will say so to the council so that nobody has to hear it from the other side.

Hesper Quill read the Sunday line twice. She did not apologise and she did not argue. She asked what it would cost her people to stop it.

04 · Three Links

The council deck, Kettle Market · Day 9, 19:00

Thirty-eight string-wardens came, and Aldana came with his Order folded in his pocket. Illuminara had drawn only three additions to the system they already ran, and she said so first.

IlluminaraI am not bringing you a new system. You have one. I am bringing three links it is missing, and each of you can refuse yours.

Hesper QuillReed Row will carry its own Sunday. We will not do it under anybody's name in a book that the Inspector reads.

Selka DunmoreTam and I will swap. I take Reed's Sunday and Reed takes my Monday. That's a trade among neighbours. It is not a rota for the Harbour Office.

IlluminaraThat is the first link, and it is better than mine. I had a paid Sunday carrier. Yours costs nothing and will outlast any budget.

Gwil AnandAnd you want my pump.

IlluminaraI want a second one, floated mid-market, lent only through you. If you fall ill, the loan does not stop. You stay the one people ask.

Gwil AnandIf I'm still the one they ask, I will lend it.

Then Aldana unfolded the Order.

Cedric AldanaI must have a record for each vessel. I do not make the clause.

IlluminaraThen read the clause again, Inspector. Section six, paragraph b. An equivalent community arrangement may be certified in place of a vessel record, if it is held under a lease, if the water at the outfall meets the standard, and if the body that signs can be inspected without notice. It asks for outcomes and does not ask for names. Measure the water at the three stations, once a month and at random. Odalys signs a count of carries with no boat named. The book never leaves her counter.

Odalys FerreiraYou are telling me to hand the Harbourmaster a number and keep the book.

IlluminaraI am telling you that the number is what he is allowed to ask for.

Wren OdiraAnd a lease. Ten years. That is a leash, and a short one. In year ten they let go of it and Kettle is a fine.

Cedric AldanaTen is what the paragraph permits.

IlluminaraTen is what the law gives this month. I would rather ask for ten and keep the market alive than ask for thirty and meet the Harbourmaster in court with money Kettle does not have.

Wren OdiraThat is your arithmetic. It is not mine.

Illuminara let that stand. The vote was the council's and neither of them could take it from the other.

05 · The Two Boats

The smokehouse Ember, tied at the east edge · Day 14, dusk

Torvald Beck's smoke-boat had been a ferry hull once. A holding tank would not fit it. Iliana Dross's Aurelian was registered upriver at Cress Market and had been in the tie-book as visitor fourteen times.

Torvald BeckI have read the plan. It was written for the boats that were already inside the book.

Iliana DrossMy name is in your book fourteen times, and in not one of them as a member. I carry my own waste out of this harbour. I have done it for nine years. I will not be counted by your rota or inspected by your Inspector.

IlluminaraHe is right, Iliana. The book holds only those who tie, and I read the market through it. That is a hole in my method, not only in the plan.

She turned to Wren, who had sat on Beck's deck three nights running and eaten his fish.

Wren OdiraI have two requests. That Beck and Dross each sit at the council until the lease is signed. And that the fund pays for whatever Beck needs, because he will not ask.

IlluminaraBeck. A sealed float-tank towed astern of Ember, nineteen hundred marks, built by Gwil's apprentice. It is not elegant. It would work.

Torvald BeckAnd my name stays out of the Reed Row sheet.

IlluminaraIt was never in it.

Torvald BeckThen the council can vote on the tank.

Iliana DrossI tie here eleven days a year. I will not be inspected for the other three hundred and fifty-four.

IlluminaraThen I will not ask you to be counted. A free rinse at the barge quay on any day you tie, with no entry in anyone's book. If the water reads clean in spring, you will know whose doing that was, and you can decide again.

Dross did not say yes. She weighed it the way a woman weighs a rope. In the morning the Aurelian had cast off for Cress Market, with a day-pass in her pocket and her reasons unrevised.

06 · What the Water Said

The quay and Reed Row · Day 27, 17:00

The trial had run ten days: Reed Row's Sunday carries, Gwil's second pump on its float, and the Ember's tank, towed astern and humming faintly with a pump of its own.

Pia ZaneSunday ebb. Upstream, a hundred and five. Reed Row, three hundred and ten. Mid-market, a hundred and seventy. Below the market, one-ninety.

Cedric AldanaFrom twenty-three hundred to three hundred ten at the mouth. And downstream from seven hundred to one-ninety.

Pia ZaneThe tannery is still adding its share. It is a hundred and five. The standard at the outfall is two hundred.

Aldana read the certificate aloud. It named the Kettle Council as the signing body, ten years as the term, three stations, random sampling and no list of boats. He signed under the line. Hesper Quill signed beneath him. Nobody cheered, because the water was still brown and the standard was still a number on a van.

Wren OdiraI still say ten is a leash.

IlluminaraSo do I. What would you change?

Wren OdiraPost the three numbers on the quay every month, where any boat can read them. A lease the whole harbour can read is harder to cancel than one in a drawer.

IlluminaraThat is stronger than the clause I wrote. Put it to the council.

Odalys opened the book on the counter. She did not ask for permission and she did not offer to show it. She wrote one line, in pencil.

Sunday, Reed 7. Carried. Tam.

IlluminaraMay I see the page?

Odalys FerreiraNo. It is not your page.

Illuminara smiled, which was not a thing she often did in front of strangers. Out on the water the ebb ran past the market a little clearer than it had on the day she arrived, and Wren, who had been right on the first morning and would be right about the lease in ten years, stood on the quay and read the numbers aloud to the boats.

DAN, KO JE IMELA WREN PRAV

01 · Čisti načrt

Pomol pristaniškega urada, Sorrel Water · 3. dan od 30, 08:10

Odredba je bila dolga štirinajst strani in je določala trideset dni, tretje jutro pa je Illuminara svoj odgovor razgrnila čez pult pristaniškega urada na enem samem listu.

Na tržnici Kettle je živelo dvanajststo gospodinjstev na barkah. Sanitarna odredba pristaniškega poveljnika št. 14 je določala, da po petnajstem novembru nobeno od njih ne sme več izpuščati odplak v Sorrel Water, avgustovski vzorci pa so pokazali, da ima odredba prav. Illuminarin list je prikazoval licencirano barko za praznjenje, šest stalnih postaj, senzor v vsakem rezervoarju in en mesečni račun.

Cedric AldanaTo je najčistejši načrt za skladnost, kar mi jih je kdo položil pred oči. Vsako plovilo izmerjeno, vsako praznjenje zabeleženo. Podpisal bi ga lahko v petek.

Wren Odira se je povzpela po stopnicah pomola z dimom v plašču in rečnim blatom do kolen. Tri tedne je spala na palubah drugih ljudi. List je dvakrat prebrala stoje in ga odložila.

Wren OdiraPropadel bo.

IlluminaraPovej mi, kje bo najprej počil.

Wren OdiraPovsod, kjer bo barka, ko se bo niz premaknil. Kettle ne miruje pri šestih postajah. Ob vsaki oseki se na novo poveže v splave in barke drsijo bliže barkam, ki jim nekaj dolgujejo. Na tvoji šesti postaji je v ponedeljek sto štirideset trupov, v četrtek pa šestdeset. In meriš rezervoar. Kdor plačuje po rezervoarju, se nauči, kako ga ohraniti napol praznega in cev dolgo.

IlluminaraMerilnik, ki družino nagradi, če pusti pristanišče umazano. Tega nisem vključila v model.

Wren OdiraModelirala si stroj. To pa je govorica z razporedom.

Illuminara lista ni branila. Wren razume njegovo obliko. Sama še nimam niti enega dejstva, vrednega več od njenih treh tednov.

IlluminaraPotem nekaj že deluje. Avgusta je bila voda slaba, ne smrtonosna, Kettle pa na njej živi trideset let. Kdo vodi zapis o tem, kako?

Wren OdiraObstaja knjiga.

Cedric AldanaOdredba zahteva zapis za vsako plovilo. Knjiga ni zapis.

Rekel je zahteva, ne pa predpisuje, in roka mu je segla k prepognjeni odredbi v prsnem žepu, še preden je besedo izgovoril. Ne zavrača. Govori mi, da obstajajo vrata, ki jih sam morda ne sme odpreti.

IlluminaraAli odredba hoče kaj še bolj kot zapis za vsako plovilo?

Cedric AldanaObstaja nekaj, kar bo sprejela namesto njega. Hkrati potrebuje tri stvari: zakup, čisto vodo pri iztoku in podpisnika, ki ga lahko brez opozorila pregledam. Kettle nikoli ni imel podpisnika. Če določim ureditev in ta propade, je neuspeh moj, zato je ne bom določil.

IlluminaraPravkar ste določili tri stvari.

Cedric AldanaNavedel sem predpis. To je dovoljeno.

IlluminaraPotem bi rada prebrala knjigo, preden vam povem, kaj je zapis.

02 · Privezna knjiga

Pult upravnice pomola, tržnica Kettle · 4. dan, 06:00

Odalys Ferreira je pod svojim pultom hranila enajst zvezkov privezne knjige, zapisane s svinčnikom, ker črnilo na mokrem pomolu steče. Odprla je tekoči zvezek in na njem držala eno dlan.

Odalys FerreiraBerete lahko tukaj. Strani ne smete prepisati, in če vas zalotim, da berete ime, za katero vas niso vprašali, knjigo zaprem. To je edina stvar na vodi, ki je še nihče ni mogel kupiti.

Illuminara je brala šest ur. Selka je peljala Reed 3, 5, 7. Tor. Črpanje pri Mill 2, od Gwila. Nazaj do mraka. Privezani: Aurelian, obiskovalec. Vrstico za vrstico je pustila, da so se vnosi sestavili v graf: nizi skupaj privezanih bark, prevozniki, ki so odpadke na dneve po izbiri posameznega niza vozili do pomola črpalne barke, ter črpalke, ki so potovale na dano besedo.

Nihče ni zapisal razporeda. Knjiga je bila razpored, voden v edinem jeziku, ki mu je tržnica zaupala.

IlluminaraOsem bark od desetih preda odpadke prevozniku, prevoznik jih pelje do licenciranega pomola, knjiga pa kaže enajst let popravkov. Osemintrideset nizov, nobeden pa pristaniškega poveljnika še nikoli ni prosil za nič.

Wren OdiraSaj sem ti povedala.

IlluminaraSi, in glede oblike si imela prav. Sistem odpove na treh mestih, najdem pa jih po tem, česar knjiga ne vsebuje. Prvo je Reed Row. Ob torkih in petkih, vsak teden enajst let. Niti enega prevoza v nedeljo.

Odalys FerreiraNedelja je počitek. Reed Row počiva najbolj od vseh nizov.

IlluminaraPoglejte strani o posojanju črpalk. Na njih so zapisane velikosti rezervoarjev, na Reed Row pa so najmanjši v pristanišču. Poglejte vnose privezov. Obiskovalci se v petek in soboto privežejo k Reed Row, petkov prevoz pa rezervoarje izprazni pred njihovim prihodom. In tukaj, na robu šestega zvezka: razbremenilni ventil, Reed Row, popravljen. Odalys FerreiraVentil je ventil.

IlluminaraRazbremenilni ventil se odpre, ko je rezervoar poln in vsebina nima kam. Poln rezervoar, obiskovalci čez konec tedna, nobenega prevoznika in nedeljska oseka, ki vse odnese.

Odalys je rob pogledala, kakor da bi ga napisal nekdo drug. Ni rekla ničesar, kar je bilo pri njej odgovor.

IlluminaraDrugo. Vsako posojilo črpalke v tem zvezku navaja Gwila Ananda ali Gwilovo rezervno črpalko. Ena črpalka, en lastnik, on pa ima devetinsedemdeset let.

Odalys FerreiraGwil Anand bo preživel pristanišče.

IlluminaraTretje, in to je tisto, kar zanima inšpektorja. Tukaj nič ne omogoča, da bi odredba izvedela, da se je karkoli od tega zgodilo, ne da bi mu odprli knjigo.

Odalys FerreiraTemu je knjiga namenjena.

IlluminaraVem. K temu se bom vrnila. Toda prva dva sta za zdaj le moj sum, polovica pristanišča pa bo rekla, da je voda umazana zaradi usnjarskega odtoka više ob reki.

Wren OdiraTo bodo rekli, še preden boš dokončala stavek.

IlluminaraPotem bomo merili, preden bo kdorkoli karkoli zatrjeval.

03 · Štiri postaje

Sorrel Water med oseko · od sobote, 22:00, do ponedeljka, 06:00

Pia Zane, ki je iz kombija vodila inšpektorjev majhen laboratorij, je postavila štiri vzorčne postaje: eno nad tržnico, eno pri ustju Reed Row, eno sredi tržnice in eno pod njo. Illuminara ji je povedala, kateri rezultati bi govorili proti Illuminari.

Napovedi je zapisala na kartico, jo zapečatila in pred polnjenjem prve steklenice izročila Aldani. Če je nedeljska vrzel resnična, bo ustje Reed Row ob nedeljski oseki pokazalo vsaj petkrat sobotno vrednost, postaja nad tržnico pa bo ostala nespremenjena. Če je vzrok usnjarna, bo postaja više ob reki obe noči kazala veliko, Reed Row pa se bo od nje komaj razlikoval. Če ni ne eno ne drugo, bo povsod enako in njeno branje knjige bo napačno.

Na kartici je pisalo tudi, da je četrta postaja, pod tržnico, iztok ter da standard dvesto velja tam in nikjer drugje. Reed Row bo pri lastnem ustju pokazal veliko. To bo diagnoza, ne potrdilo skladnosti.

IlluminaraVzorčim edino mesto, za katero vaš niz ne more jamčiti. Če bo številka v nedeljo slaba, bo to prvo dejstvo, ki ga imava obe in ga lahko popravimo.

Hesper QuillKaj pa, če bo slaba tudi v soboto?

IlluminaraPotem se motim, in tako piše tudi na kartici.

Wren je sama odveslala po steklenice, odsek za odsekom. Rezultati so prispeli v ponedeljek ob šestih, v enterokokih na sto mililitrov.

Pia ZaneSobotna oseka. Više ob reki devetdeset. Reed Row dvesto deset. Sredi tržnice sto osemdeset. Pod tržnico dvesto šestdeset. Nedeljska oseka. Više ob reki sto deset. Reed Row dva tisoč tristo. Sredi tržnice šeststo štirideset. Spodaj sedemsto.

Wren OdiraViše ob reki je nespremenjeno.

Pia ZaneUsnjarna po dežju nekaj doda. To ni to.

IlluminaraUsnjarna je dejstvo, ni pa to dejstvo. Tam bo še vedno, ko bomo končali, in to bom svetu povedala sama, da tega nikomur ne bo treba slišati z druge strani.

Hesper Quill je nedeljsko vrstico prebrala dvakrat. Ni se opravičila in ni ugovarjala. Vprašala je, koliko bo njene ljudi stalo, da to ustavijo.

04 · Tri povezave

Paluba sveta, tržnica Kettle · 9. dan, 19:00

Prišlo je osemintrideset varuhov nizov, Aldana pa je prišel z odredbo, prepognjeno v žepu. Illuminara je sistemu, ki so ga že vodili, dodala le tri stvari in je to povedala najprej.

IlluminaraNe prinašam vam novega sistema. Enega že imate. Prinašam tri povezave, ki mu manjkajo, vsako od njih pa lahko zavrnete.

Hesper QuillReed Row bo sam poskrbel za svojo nedeljo. Tega ne bomo počeli pod imenom kogarkoli v knjigi, ki jo bere inšpektor.

Selka DunmoreS Tamom bova zamenjala. Jaz prevzamem Reedovo nedeljo, Reed pa moj ponedeljek. To je menjava med sosedi. Ni razpored za pristaniški urad.

IlluminaraTo je prva povezava in boljša je od moje. Sama sem predvidela plačanega nedeljskega prevoznika. Vaša ne stane nič in bo preživela vsak proračun.

Hesper QuillNi zastonj. Tam dela na dan, ko še nikoli ni delal, Reed Row pa mu za to plača iz lastne blagajne. Sveta ne bomo prosili za denar.

Gwil AnandIn vi hočete mojo črpalko.

IlluminaraHočem drugo, nameščeno na plovec sredi tržnice in posojeno samo prek vas. Če zbolite, se posojanje ne ustavi. Vi ostanete tisti, ki ga ljudje vprašajo.

Gwil AnandČe še vedno mene vprašajo, jo bom posojal.

Tedaj je Aldana razgrnil odredbo.

Cedric AldanaImeti moram zapis za vsako plovilo. Klavzule ne določam jaz.

IlluminaraPotem klavzulo preberite še enkrat, inšpektor. Šesti člen, odstavek b. Enakovredna skupnostna ureditev se lahko potrdi namesto zapisa o plovilu, če je sklenjena z zakupom, če voda pri iztoku ustreza standardu in če je mogoče telo, ki se podpiše, pregledati brez opozorila. Zahteva izide. Ne zahteva imen.

IlluminaraKnjiga je razlog, da je voda čista, in ne bo zapustila Odalysinega pulta. Svet ima zakup. Voda se enkrat mesečno meri na treh postajah, na naključne dni. Telo, ki se podpiše, pa je ta svet, katerega edini podpisani papir je število prevozov brez imen bark, zato lahko vstopite brez opozorila in preštejete listke.

Odalys FerreiraPravite mi, naj pristaniškemu poveljniku dam številko, knjigo pa obdržim.

IlluminaraPravim vam, da je številka vse, kar sme zahtevati.

Wren OdiraIn zakup. Deset let. To je povodec, in še kratek. V desetem letu ga spustijo in Kettle postane globa.

Cedric AldanaDeset je toliko, kolikor dovoljuje odstavek.

IlluminaraDeset je toliko, kolikor nam ta mesec daje zakon. Raje prosim za deset in ohranim tržnico pri življenju, kakor da prosim za trideset in se s pristaniškim poveljnikom srečam na sodišču z denarjem, ki ga Kettle nima.

Wren OdiraTo je tvoja računica. Ni moja.

Illuminara je pustila, da obvelja. Glasovanje je pripadalo svetu. Enaintrideset nizov je glasovalo za, sedem proti, v zapisnik pa so vnesli sedem zavrnitev, ki jih bodo znova prebrali ob vsakem podaljšanju. Ne ona ne Wren je nista mogli odvzeti drugi.

05 · Dve barki

Dimna barka Ember, privezana na vzhodnem robu · 14. dan, mrak

Dimna barka Torvalda Becka je bila nekoč trajekt in vanjo ni bilo mogoče namestiti nobenega zadrževalnega rezervoarja. Aurelian Iliane Dross je bil registriran više ob reki, na tržnici Cress, v privezni knjigi pa je bil štirinajstkrat vpisan kot obiskovalec.

Torvald BeckPrebral sem načrt. Napisan je bil za barke, ki so bile že v knjigi.

Iliana DrossMoje ime je v vaši knjigi štirinajstkrat in niti enkrat kot članica. Svoje odpadke sama odpeljem iz tega pristanišča. To počnem že devet let. Ne bom se pustila šteti po vašem razporedu ali pregledovati vašemu inšpektorju.

IlluminaraPrav ima, Iliana. V knjigi so samo tisti, ki se privežejo, sama pa sem tržnico brala skoznjo. To je vrzel v moji metodi, ne le v načrtu.

Obrnila se je k Wren, ki je tri noči zapored sedela na Beckovi palubi in jedla njegove ribe.

Wren OdiraImam dve zahtevi. Da Beck in Dross sedita v svetu, dokler zakup ni podpisan. In da nedeljski sklad, ki ga je Reed Row odprl za Tama, plača tudi vse, kar potrebuje Beck, ker sam ne bo prosil.

IlluminaraHesper je s tem soglašala in vprašala sem jo sinoči. Beck, zapečaten plavajoči rezervoar, ki bi ga vlekli za Ember, tisoč devetsto mark, izdelal pa bi ga Gwilov vajenec. Ni eleganten. Deloval bi.

Torvald BeckMoje ime pa ostane zunaj lista Reed Row.

IlluminaraNikoli ga ni bilo na njem.

Torvald BeckPotem lahko svet glasuje o rezervoarju.

Iliana DrossTukaj se privežem enajst dni na leto. Preostalih tristo štiriinpetdeset dni ne bom dovolila pregledovanja.

IlluminaraPotem vas ne bom prosila, da vas štejejo. Brezplačno izpiranje pri pomolu črpalne barke na katerikoli dan, ko se privežete, brez vnosa v katerokoli knjigo. Če bo voda spomladi čista, boste vedeli, čigavo delo je bilo, in se boste lahko znova odločili.

Dross ni rekla da. Pretehtala je ponudbo tako, kakor ženska pretehta vrv. Zjutraj je Aurelian odplul proti tržnici Cress, z dnevnim dovoljenjem v njenem žepu in njenimi razlogi nespremenjenimi.

06 · Kar je povedala voda

Pomol in Reed Row · 27. dan, 17:00

Poskus je trajal deset dni: nedeljski prevozniki Reed Row, Gwilova druga črpalka na plovcu in Emberjev rezervoar, ki ga je vlekla za seboj in je tiho brnel z lastno črpalko.

Pia ZaneNedeljska oseka. Više ob reki sto pet. Reed Row tristo deset. Sredi tržnice sto sedemdeset. Pod tržnico sto devetdeset.

Cedric AldanaReed Row z dva tisoč tristo na tristo deset pri lastnem ustju. Pod tržnico s sedemsto na sto devetdeset. Iztok je pod dvesto.

Pia ZaneUsnjarna še vedno prispeva svoj delež. Ta je sto pet. Standard pri iztoku je dvesto.

Aldana je potrdilo prebral na glas. Kot podpisno telo je imenovalo svet Kettle, kot obdobje deset let, tri postaje, naključno vzorčenje in nobenega seznama bark. Pod vrstico se je podpisal. Pod njim se je podpisala Hesper Quill. Nihče ni vzklikal, kajti voda je bila še vedno rjava in standard še vedno številka na kombiju.

Wren OdiraŠe vedno pravim, da je deset let povodec.

IlluminaraTudi jaz. Kaj bi spremenila?

Wren OdiraVsak mesec objavite tri številke na pomolu, kjer jih lahko prebere vsaka barka. Zakup, ki ga lahko bere vse pristanišče, je težje odpovedati kot tistega v predalu.

IlluminaraTo je močnejše od klavzule, ki sem jo napisala. Predloži svetu.

Odalys je na pultu odprla knjigo. Ni prosila za dovoljenje in ni ponudila, da jo bo pokazala. S svinčnikom je zapisala eno vrstico.

Nedelja, Reed 7. Prepeljano. Tam.

IlluminaraSmem videti stran?

Odalys FerreiraNe. To ni vaša stran.

Illuminara se je nasmehnila, česar pred neznanci ni počela pogosto. Zunaj na vodi je oseka tekla mimo tržnice nekoliko čistejša kot na dan njenega prihoda, Wren, ki je imela prav prvo jutro in bo glede zakupa imela prav čez deset let, pa je stala na pomolu in barkam na glas brala številke.

THE COUGH THAT FOLLOWED THE BELLS

Forty-one children cough every Sunday night in a mountain town that has spent five weeks blaming its doctors and its church, and nobody has asked which bell, which room, or what changed last winter.

01 · Forty-One Notebooks

Children's clinic, Ostrava Vell · Monday, 07:40

Ostrava Vell was a mountain town of four thousand people, one church with a tower too large for it, and, since the second week of September, forty-one children who coughed in the evenings.

Dr. Ilse Varga had taped her spirometry curves to the examination-room wall, one line to a child. Every line sagged on Sunday night and climbed back by Thursday, forty-one small tides.

Ilse VargaCultures, PCR, serology, three rounds. There is nothing in any of them. No virus I know keeps a calendar.

Judit Moravec, who chaired the town council, had come in with her coat on and meant to leave in it. Father Matej Hroch of St. Wenzel stood by the door with his hands folded in his sleeves.

Judit MoravecThe council wants the school shut on Wednesday. A closed school is a thing I can actually do. Tell me what else I can do by Wednesday and I will do that instead.

Ilse VargaI can tell you that it costs the fifteen-year-olds their exams in six weeks, and that I cannot promise it helps.

Matej HrochAnd while you are all looking for something to shut, leave the bells out of it. This town blamed them for the hail, the frost and the winter the cows failed. They were innocent every time.

Illuminara had been asked to read the evidence rather than the people. She stood a while before the curves, then before the map beside them, where each child was a pin in the street they lived on and the pins thickened toward the church.

IlluminaraEveryone has plotted the children by where they live. Has anyone plotted them by where they sleep?

Ilse VargaWhere they sleep is where they live.

IlluminaraUsually.

Nives Hadzic had come in with her coat still buttoned. She held out a school exercise book, soft at the corners.

Nives HadzicForty-one mothers, forty-one notebooks. You asked for them in week two, Doctor. I write down every cough and the hour. And Lenka does not fit. We are out on Spindle Road, past the cemetery, the farthest house from the tower there is. She coughs on Sundays like the rest of them.

Ilse VargaI set Lenka aside as an outlier.

Illuminara turned the pages. Saturday: to Baba's. Sunday: home at five. Sunday night: coughing, two hours.

IlluminaraWhere is Baba's?

Nives HadzicCooper's Lane. Right under the tower, near enough.

IlluminaraThen she is not an outlier. She is the one child you have who proves something. The cough follows the child and not the address, so it is not a house or a street, and probably not a germ going door to door. It is a room she slept in, and the room has a clock.

The doctors had asked what was in the children. Nobody had asked what was in the rooms.

Judit MoravecAnd the school?

IlluminaraTell me which of these children sleep there.

02 · Saint's Flour

St. Wenzel's tower, ringing chamber · Monday, 10:15

The ringing chamber smelled of rope and cold stone. Dana Kral had pulled the bells of St. Wenzel for thirty-eight years, as her husband had before her, and she watched the stranger look at the ropes instead of the bells and made ready to be annoyed.

IlluminaraI have one question, and I think nobody has asked it. Which bell is the heaviest, and when is it rung?

Dana KralEverybody asks which is loudest.

IlluminaraI am not asking about loud.

Dana KralOld Wenzel. Two tonnes and a hundred kilos. Four of us swing him, Sundays and feast days only. The little ones go from the keyboard, and the hour bells strike by the clock, every day of the week.

Matej HrochThere, you see. The hour bells strike every day and nobody coughs on a Tuesday.

IlluminaraI agree. So it is not the bells. It may be one bell, on one day.

She asked for a single stroke of the old bell. Hroch looked a long time at the rope, and allowed exactly one. Dana and three ringers swung Old Wenzel up from rest, and Illuminara went down to the ground chamber and stood on the flagstones at the west wall.

The stroke came through the tower like a blow to the bottom of a chair. She had never needed her ears for a bell. The tower pressed its weight into the stone, the stone passed it down, and she read where the paths ran. Under the west wall they stopped. There was one place where the rock no longer carried anything and only hung, a long emptiness with a thin roof, and it answered the stroke the way a drumhead answers a palm.

Something down there rings.

IlluminaraUnder this wall there is a hollow, wide and shallow, with a thin ceiling over it. When Old Wenzel strikes, the ceiling moves.

Matej HrochThe tower stands on rock.

Dana KralIt stands on the lip of the old adit. The miners' air shaft, bricked and boarded before my grandmother's time. Mind the floor by the lectern, it is hollow.

She pushed back her sleeve. Along the dark wool lay a fine white powder, like flour.

Dana KralSaint's flour. It comes up between the boards on every feast day. Ringers have worn it for three hundred years. My grandmother said it was Wenzel blessing our hands.

IlluminaraThen it is not new. Something else is.

Emil RaskI can tell you what is new.

The chimney sweep had come up the tower stairs behind them with his apprentice and a bag of rods. He was sixty-eight years old and filled the doorway.

Emil RaskLast winter's grant. I did sixty-three chimneys for it in the old quarter. New stoves, sealed windows, no draught, less coal. I told the council what I tell everyone. A house with its windows shut drinks from its cellar.

Dana KralAnd did the council listen?

Emil RaskThey liked the part about the coal.

A bell that had rung for three hundred years, and a grant that had saved sixty-three households a winter's fuel. Neither dangerous alone.

03 · Two Mouths

Cooper's Lane, cellars of the old quarter · Tuesday, 14:00

Emil Rask had one rule for entering a cellar and he gave it on every doorstep: the tenant says yes, or the rods stay in the bag.

Eleven of the twelve said yes. Alois Fenner, at number nine, stood in his doorway with his arms folded.

Alois FennerMy father's cellar and his father's. Nobody counts my air.

Emil RaskThen I cannot map it, Alois. Not without you.

Alois FennerThen don't.

Illuminara could have found the mouth of that cellar in half a minute. She looked at the sweep, and at the folded arms, and left the cellar unread. The map would have a gap in it.

In Baba Hadzic's cellar the apprentice, Tilo, who was sixteen and had been told to say nothing, lit a smoke pencil by the coal bin and held it to the wall. The thread of smoke lay over and leaned toward a bricked arch behind the bin, where the mortar was thin enough to feel a cold breath through.

TiloIt is pulling in. All of it, here.

The sweep took the pencil to a grating in the cellar's other wall. The smoke leaned that way too.

Emil RaskTwo mouths. Don't you tell me it is one. The arch feeds this room, and so does the street.

IlluminaraI won't. The street air should be nearly clean and the arch should not, but I cannot claim either until something counts them. If I am wrong about the arch, a stove on a Tuesday would be breathing what a stove breathes on a Sunday.

Ilse Varga had arrived with three laser dust counters in a padded case.

Ilse VargaNobody says the word silica in my clinic until a counter says particles.

IlluminaraAgreed. Then a test that can lose. Wednesday at three, when no one is baking and no one is at church. Counters in three cellars: Baba Hadzic's, one at the school on the far edge, one down the lane. Ten minutes of the small bells only. Then Old Wenzel alone, for ten.

IlluminaraIf the school's counter climbs with Baba's, the dust is in the air everywhere and I am wrong. If the small bells raise Baba's, it is the tower and not the shaft, and I am wrong again. If Baba's has not at least quadrupled within twenty minutes of the first stroke, I am wrong a third way.

Ilse VargaAnd if you are right?

IlluminaraThen we still do not know what the dust is. That needs a lab.

Emil RaskAnd I want the grating counted by itself. A counter in the pipe.

IlluminaraYou shall have one.

04 · Wednesday, Out of Season

St. Wenzel's tower and three cellars · Wednesday, 15:00

Nobody could order Old Wenzel rung. Four ringers swung him by their own wish or not at all, and the wish was Dana Kral's.

Dana KralI will ring him on a Wednesday, which I have never done, for ten minutes, which I have never wanted. If one telephone call comes from the clinic with a child's name in it, I stop on the spot, and I do not care what is on your counters.

Matej HrochAnd I will stand in my tower and watch you do it.

The mothers had decided among themselves that no child should be in the old quarter's cellars that afternoon. Nives Hadzic had chalked it on the schoolyard gate. Ilse Varga read the counters over the telephone from the clinic.

Ilse VargaBaseline, all three: Baba Hadzic's twenty-two, the school nineteen, Cooper's Lane twenty-four. Stoves are lit, same as any weekday. Small bells, now.

The five small bells chimed for ten minutes, bright and a little silly in the dry air.

Ilse VargaTwenty-one. Twenty. Twenty-four. Nothing.

Matej HrochThe bells are innocent.

IlluminaraThe small ones are. Dana.

Four ringers, one rope, and Old Wenzel went up from rest and spoke. The note was lower than anything the ear could hold. It lived in the soles of the feet.

05 · One Course of Brick

The old air shaft and the adit beneath the west wall · Thursday, 06:00

Hroch had allowed one course of brick to be lifted from the tower floor, and had asked that it be put back. Under it a shaft a metre wide, plastered smooth, fell into the dark. Emil Rask had put a torch on the timbers below.

Emil RaskThat roof has been rotting since my grandfather's day. Anything that goes down there goes on a rope, and I would be burying it.

She went down into a dark that was a kind of information. The gallery ran a hundred and forty metres under Cooper's Lane, its roof lined with lime plaster and sharp white sand that in places had come away from the rock and hung in sheets. On the floor lay three centimetres of dust the colour of flour. Where she stepped it rose and stayed in the air like a held breath.

IlluminaraEleven hundred where I stand. The arch you smoked is sixty-two metres east. The street grating's branch joins at forty metres and its air is clean, and it carries about a tenth of it, as you said. I will say so at the table.

She took three samples in glass: plaster, floor dust, and a flake of the tower's own limestone. It would have been easy to feel certain. She made herself wait for the lab.

One thing she had not expected: the bell arrived in the gallery as pressure. Every stroke pumped the long tunnel like a bellows, and each pump drove the dust east along the floor toward the arch.

IlluminaraEmil. If you plug that arch, the plug needs a breather: a pipe to the open air, far from any window. Otherwise the bell will press the dust through the old mortar around whatever you build, like water through a sponge.

Eleven metres. It took four hours.

IlluminaraA hundred and twenty-nine metres remain untouched. The worst of it is covered. It is not all of it. I want that written down.

The lab result reached the clinic on Friday morning.

Ilse VargaAngular quartz, three to eight microns, in a lime binder. The same as your gallery plaster. No quartz in the tower limestone. No pigeon. Father, your stone is clean.

FOUR KILOMETRES OF THIN ICE

Twenty-three people breathe the last of their air under four kilometres of ice, and a rescue vessel built to survive exactly one trip.

01 · The Placard

Marrow Station, surface of the moon Tavret · Hour 0

The air clock for Halcyon was a magnetic placard on the control-room wall, and someone had been changing its digits by hand. It read 31:00. Underneath, in marker, a second number: 23.

Ofelia BrandtHalcyon sits on the ocean four thousand and ten metres below this floor. Twenty-three people, saturated at six bar, so they cannot simply be pulled up. The shaft froze round the lift cage at 03:40 and the automatic marked the cage lost. We have one vessel that can go down. Curlew, a drone-sub, six seats, nine hours to reach the shaft.

Illuminara stood at the placard rather than the screens. She had come up from the lower decks twenty minutes earlier, and nobody had yet asked her to sit.

Imre SolanoThe hull certificate is for one excursion to rated depth. Down and back. The lab cycled twelve test hulls and two cracked on the second excursion. I won't fly a second one, and you shouldn't ask me to.

Ofelia BrandtSo six come up. Seventeen don't. I have been told to draw lots, and I would rather resign.

IlluminaraWhat exactly does the certificate count?

Imre SolanoPressure excursions. Full cycles.

IlluminaraNot seats, and not people. Then the excursion is the scarce thing, and I'd like to ask what it is best spent on before we ask who sits in it.

Ofelia BrandtIt carries six. That's what it is for.

IlluminaraWho says the cage is dead?

Ofelia BrandtIt stopped moving, and the shaft is ice around it.

IlluminaraStopped is not dead. May I see what it has been saying since 03:40?

02 · The Trace

Halcyon, 4,010 m below · Hour 2

The habitat's voice came up the cable thin and a little late. Illuminara spoke to the commander first and to the engineer second, because the commander would decide and the engineer would know.

Marit OseiI've heard about the lots. I will not run them. If someone has a plan that is not a plan to choose who dies, say it quickly, because my people are watching me listen.

IlluminaraI have a question rather than a plan. Maud Okonkwo logged the cage's frame strain. Maud, there is a wobble in it.

Maud OkonkwoSensor noise. It rises and falls, a third or so. I flagged it and wrote it off.

Illuminara laid the trace beside a second line: the moon's flex cycle, the swell and slackening of the ice shell as Tavret's orbit pulled it. The peaks of the wobble sat on the peaks of the flex, every three hours and fourteen minutes.

IlluminaraNoise does not keep the moon's time. I think the cage is not held by the shaft. It is held by ice that is squeezed against it, and every time the shell relaxes, the squeeze eases. That gives us a door that opens for a few minutes every three hours and fourteen.

Maud OkonkwoThen you have the wrong picture, and it matters. The shaft is clear above and below. I put a camera on it at hour one. The ice is on the three roller carriages and fourteen metres of rack. Free those and the cage is free.

Fourteen metres, not a plug a hundred long. Illuminara took the correction the way she took a good measurement, with gratitude and without ceremony. It made the plan smaller. It also made it possible.

Marit OseiAnd you want my people to bet their lives on a wobble.

IlluminaraI want them to measure it, which costs only waiting. The next peak is at Hour 6 and twenty-six minutes. If the strain does not fall by at least a third and stay down for five minutes, I am wrong, and the director's lots are the plan. I'll say so myself.

03 · One Excursion

Marrow Station, control room · Hour 6, 26 minutes

Maud Okonkwo read the number aloud as it fell, and the room, which had not been quiet, became so.

Maud OkonkwoDown thirty-eight percent. Holding. Five minutes. Nine. It's coming back up now.

Ofelia BrandtSo the door exists. What holds it?

IlluminaraI do, partly, and I want you to hear my limit rather than guess it. At the peak I can hold the cage's weight off its rollers for eight minutes. At the trough ninety seconds. I can hold that weight or I can keep the ice walls from closing on a cut lane. Not both for more than ninety seconds.

Ofelia BrandtSeats save six and spend the hull.

IlluminaraAnd leave seventeen with air and nothing left to come for them. A second excursion is the other road, and Imre has told us what it costs. The frame saves nobody directly, but it is the only plan with a second step.

Imre SolanoThen the walls need something else.

IlluminaraA frame. Four titanium struts that jack the lane open, with a hot-water lance for the three carriages. Curlew can carry it. It takes the seat bay, so Curlew goes down once, to the collar at three thousand three hundred and fifty metres, not to the habitat. It never touches a passenger. It uses its one excursion, and it comes home.

Brandt looked at the placard. Six seats were a thing she could picture. A frame was a promise.

Ofelia BrandtAnd if your eight minutes fail?

IlluminaraThen Curlew is spent and so are we, and I will have cost you the six. I am sure of the arithmetic. I am not sure of the ice. So the first window frees an empty cage. If I fail there, nobody is in it.

Imre SolanoI'll fly it once. I won't fly it twice.

Ofelia BrandtLoad the frame.

04 · The Order

Halcyon, wet porch and crew deck · Hour 7

The cage was rated for twelve, by weight on the rack. That left a number nobody wanted to say, and Commander Osei said it.

Marit OseiTwelve now. Eleven later. The second ride waits for more windows. Which of you goes first is our decision, not the surface's, and it is not going to be a draw.

Anselm DubeI'll propose, and you can tear it up. First lift: the stretcher cases, the over-fifties, the three who feel the cold worst. Everyone whose body gets less safe the longer it waits. They also breathe fastest, so when they leave, the air for the rest doesn't last thirty-one hours. It lasts a day and a half.

Kofi MensahAnd who is last?

Anselm DubeThe ones who can still work. Maud, the three of us on the rack, the commander. The people who run the place.

Kofi MensahThat isn't an order, that's a sentence. You're making the strongest wait because they can.

Marit OseiYes. And any of you can say no to it, and nobody in this room will think less of you.

Nobody said no. Kofi Mensah, who had been younger than the argument, asked instead what the first group could do for the second. The answer was the rack: someone had to go out into the black water, at ambient pressure, with a hot hose, and clear the last six metres where the cage would land. Maud, Anselm and Kofi suited up. They would pay for it with forty hours in a chamber afterwards, and they knew the price before they asked.

05 · Eight Minutes

The collar, 3,350 m down · Hour 9, 40 minutes

Illuminara had come down beside the cable, past the point where light was an idea, and the cold and the pressure meant what they always meant to her, which was information. The ice shell lay around the bore like a held breath. She could read where it carried load. She could read where it was about to close.

Curlew hung at the collar with the frame folded in its belly. Solano's voice in the water was calm and slightly hoarse.

Imre SolanoStruts deploying. Lane walls at one metre. Lance in two minutes. Peak window opens now.

She took the cage's weight. It came into her like a held note, fourteen tonnes of rack and steel that the ice was trying to keep. The first carriage let go at minute two. The second at minute four. The third did not.

Imre SolanoCarriage three isn't releasing. Minute five. Three left.

Maud OkonkwoThat carriage has a shear pin on the east face. It's the one I always said we should replace. Hit it from the east.

Solano swung the lance. Illuminara felt the pin go, a small bright failure, and the cage dropped out of the ice and onto its own rack for the first time in six hours. She released it at minute seven and fifty seconds.

IlluminaraThat is as long as I can hold. If it had needed ten seconds more, it would not have been me who could give them.

The cage ran down toward the habitat at a stately two-tenths of a metre a second, empty, and the voices from Halcyon began to cheer, and she let them.

06 · The Second Ride

Marrow Station, surface chamber · Hour 17, 40 minutes

The twelve rose at the second window, and she held for seven minutes and thirty seconds. This time there was weight in the cage, and the weight had names. The cage went up through the collar zone with its lights on and its stretchers latched, and then there was only a long climb in the open bore, four and a half hours of it, six bar held inside until the chamber's door mated to the cage's door and the first twelve could begin to come down to the surface pressure at the pace their bodies allowed.

The second lift took another day. Illuminara went down for the fifth window and the sixth. Each time the frame cut, she took the weight, and each time the number of minutes was a little shorter than she had said it would be.

Marit OseiThat's the eleven. I'm the last one in. You can tell your director the habitat is switched off.

Ofelia BrandtHalcyon is a loss. The company will want to know whose fault the freeze was.

Marit OseiThe company can write it on whatever placard it likes. Twenty-three people are in a chamber with a door.

Illuminara sat on the floor of the control room for the first time since she had come up. She did not pretend to be anything but tired. She said so, plainly, to the room, and to Solano, who had flown the hull once, as promised, and brought it home.

On the wall, someone had finally wiped off the digits. In their place, in marker, was the number 23, and a line under it.

Maud OkonkwoHe's reading the trace correctly. It does relax.

Anselm DubeThree hours fourteen.

Marit OseiCounted. We have twenty hours of air and the crossing needs five. Refusal stands. We cross at 32:18.

At 31:15 the cage left the landing, and at 32:18 Illuminara took its weight, tired, and carried it across in seven minutes and fifteen seconds, fifteen seconds under what she had said.
